oneAlarmTrust.title: Would one alarm actually wake you?

insight.title: This isn’t a motivation problem.
insight.copy: When the alarm rings, your brain is still waking up. That’s why half-asleep taps win.

yes.title: Waking up isn’t the finish line.
yes.copy: One alarm gets you up — the first hour is where mornings are won. A mission before dismissal turns ‘up’ into ‘moving’.

sometimes.title: Motivation is a coin flip.
sometimes.copy: Some mornings you win, some the tap does. A mission takes the coin flip out of your morning.

personalizedSolution.title: これは意志の問題ではありません。
personalizedSolution.copy: 選んだ問題は、完全に目覚めた脳が判断する前に起きています。DawnVowはそれぞれのパターンをこう変えます。

solutions.snooze_unaware: 必須ミッションが自動的なスヌーズのループを中断します。
solutions.dismiss_fall_asleep: 眠ったままのタップと起床完了の間にミッションを置きます。
solutions.up_not_moving: The mission gets you moving before the alarm goes quiet
